name: Pure Veg Delight Cake
description: An eggless tea cake with a golden crust and a soft, moist crumb. Perfect with evening chai or as a gift.
ingredients: Wheat flour (maida), sugar, vegetable oil, vanaspati, milk solids, baking powder, baking soda, iodized salt.
storage: Keep in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening.
